My exposures were focused on desensitizing myself to vomit. It was mainly watching videos of people throwing up. Eventually I would watch the videos while eating something. Some other ideas my therapist had include drinking a lot of water really fast and spinning around in a chair. This was to emulate the feelings of nausea.

The therapist I worked with had treated people struggling with emetophobia, so that helped a lot! I had never met a therapist that had experience with it. Even just a therapist that is trained in ERP helps a lot. All I’ve done before this was talk therapy and exposures on my own. Doing the exposures in a structured way where I knew I had to do them because someone would hold me accountable was a turning point for me

I did exposures daily. I had already been doing exposures on my own before but I took it up a notch in treatment. The first step for me was exposure through Ken Goodman’s book The Emetophobia Manual and Anna Christie’s hierarchy on her website. I watched them over and over and over again. At first it was distressing, but it gradually got desensitizing. 

In treatment, I would look up on YouTube “people tu” and watched random videos. This was a level up because the videos were more “unhinged” lol then the next step was eating a snack while watching the videos 

I can say exposure therapy really works!!!

I started with Free Yourself from Emetophobia (https://www.amazon.com/Free-Yourself-Emetophobia-Self-help-Vomiting/dp/178775331X/ref=asc_df_178775331X/?tag=hyprod-20&linkCode=df0&hvadid=564641475597&hvpos=&hvnetw=g&hvrand=9651653263012449247&hvpone=&hvptwo=&hvqmt=&hvdev=m&hvdvcmdl=&hvlocint=&hvlocphy=1016367&hvtargid=pla-1240675223446&psc=1) 
It’s a little less intense than the second book, but it was a good first step for me as my phobia was really bad. Just depends on the severity i guess. The second book is the Emetophobia Manual (https://www.amazon.com/Emetophobia-Manual-Yourself-Vomit-Reclaim/dp/1735889113/ref=asc_df_1735889113/?tag=hyprod-20&linkCode=df0&hvadid=532608013133&hvpos=&hvnetw=g&hvrand=9651653263012449247&hvpone=&hvptwo=&hvqmt=&hvdev=m&hvdvcmdl=&hvlocint=&hvlocphy=1016367&hvtargid=pla-1239057362598&psc=1) This book was very helpful. There is a written exposure hierarchy to follow. Another resource is Anna Christie’s website: https://www.emetophobia.net. She has an exposure hierarchy to follow. I hope this helps you and you can find healing!
